verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's marketing describes a built-in AI agent, Tia, that fixes IT issues, writes automated session summaries and helps build automations. It also offers an in-product AI troubleshooting assistant queried in natural language. However, the evidence is only marketing copy, and the troubleshooting assistant is mainly question-and-answer rather than open-ended task delegation. Missing for 10: documentation of how users actually assign tasks to Tia and what actions it can execute autonomously, scope and limits of agentic actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Tia, your AI agent, learns from every support session to predict, prevent, and rapidly fix IT issues.
By querying our AI troubleshooting assistant, find faults and fix them fast, using natural language to get real-time, device-specific answers and insights.
Tia’s automated session summaries save you time, augment your human experts, and help Tia build new automations to cut digital friction and time-wasting repetitive tasks.
Our AI-powered note-taker compiles a summary for each case, spots patterns, highlights insights
Use advanced TeamViewer AI to analyze data, from screenshots to error logs.
